Name: Gus Gus Mod - Rooster Teeth (TM)

Description:
hola dudes! this is a rough mod to make gus from stardew valley look more like gus from rooster teeth

fyi I laughed for a solid minute when I booted up the game and tested this mod for the first time

I was never attached to vanilla gus's character, this was simple to do, IDK what the venn diagram of stardew valley players and rooster teeth fans look like, but no one asked for this lol
